about_the_game:
This Supporter Pack is for anyone who wants to spend some extra coin to support the ongoing development of Halls of Torment. In exchange, you will get some fresh visual goodies and a new training area specifically for experimenting with loadouts and setups.

By purchasing this Supporter Pack you will receive:

Supporter Skins:

Each character gets one new skin. All changes are cosmetic—abilities and stats are the same as the base characters.

HUD Styles:

Pick from a selection of three new UI designs to use while slaying through the halls.

Training Grounds:

There are two rooms available in the Training Grounds. One simulates a horde. The other includes just a single enemy to fight. With the new DPS tracker (available in the newest free update!) you can track your damage in real time and adjust your setup with the tools found in the Training Grounds.

Our Eternal Thanks:

Purchasing this pack shows your support for the game and its developers. For this we are forever thankful!
